definition: a person with very poor judgment
description: On a sunny day, the view moves from a stone courtyard, where a wedding party gathers by long white tables and string lights, up to a small balcony. There a young man in sunglasses stands shirtless in an overfilled inflatable paddling pool with a pink flamingo ring around his waist, grinning and giving a thumbs up, while water pours over the railing onto the guests below. A bride in a white dress and men in suits look up, some holding white chairs over their heads.
